property.name: subtitle
property.value: Wind, flying carpets and the final climb

property.name: text
property.value: The final ascent begins under the moon. Use everything you have learned. Lanterns mark sheltered resting places.

property.name: text
property.value: The carpet waits for you. Stay aboard! If you fall, the lower ledges let you climb back out of the ravine.

property.name: text
property.value: Face the spirits to hold them still. Save your slash for bats and jinn.
